title: Kawasaki Ninja 300 (2013), rear-wheel dyno, Motorcyclist magazine SuperFlow + MotoStatz top speed
source_note: Peak figures from Motorcyclist magazine SuperFlow dyno test: 33 hp at 11,000 rpm and 16.9 lb-ft (22.9 N·m) at 9800 rpm, rear wheel. Cycle World reported 35 peak hp on their dyno. Top speed 110 mph (177 km/h) from MotoStatz. Curve samples are estimated from typical Ninja 300 dyno curve shape and are approximate (±1 hp).
curve_method: Power samples estimated from typical Ninja 300 rear-wheel dyno curve shape; peaks from Motorcyclist magazine (33 hp @ 11,000 rpm, 16.9 lb-ft @ 9800 rpm, rear wheel).
notes: Manufacturer on-crank figures: 39 hp (29 kW) at 11,000 rpm, 27 N·m at 10,000 rpm - not used for the match. Rear-wheel figures from Motorcyclist magazine SuperFlow dyno. Cycle World reported 35 peak hp. The 4-to-6 ft-lb torque advantage over the Ninja 250R is noted in the Motorcyclist article. Not yet calibrated to this reference.
